scope: One fresh-context source review of merged switching and its tests; no solver compilation or execution by this reviewer. Parent validates runtime.
conclusion: No new commit-state, callback-fatal, or attempt-budget defect found in this source pass. Runtime validation is separate.

checks.subject: Productive same-window implicit comparator
checks.evidence: Replay begins at result.final_state/start before either trial commits; charge() occurs once; successful losing explicit trial is uncommitted; successful implicit replay commits once, updates rate/seed, and increments implicit_windows and since_probe by one.

checks.subject: Fatal comparator path
checks.evidence: Replay is charged before fatal check. Both trial records remain uncommitted. The last checkpoint is retained and windows terminate.

checks.subject: Shared attempt budget
checks.evidence: All trial max_steps values are min(global remaining, local budget). Remaining is recomputed after explicit and replay charges. Zero remaining prevents replay/advance.

checks.subject: Legacy and adaptive entry scheduling
checks.evidence: Legacy rate rearm and legacy discard bookkeeping are conditioned on adaptation=None. Adaptive memory handles entry scheduling otherwise. Legacy implicit-return backoff remains shared by design.

checks.subject: Latest native economy implementation retained
checks.evidence: Callback entry ceiling, return RHS ceiling, implicit coalescing/mean-step seed, snapshot-based persistent explicit records, static decision strings and native contract files remain present.

checks.subject: Tiny explicit tail repair
checks.evidence: Top-level validate() validates user h0 before any clamping. Valid DOPRI proposal is no longer preclipped into invalid short-tail h0; native output clipping handles landing.

checks.subject: Incomplete comparator
checks.evidence: compare_qualified_costs requires both records admissible; unsuccessful implicit replay cannot authorize explicit win, is uncommitted, and its work remains charged. A subsequent productive implicit run can retry only when global budget remains.

checks.subject: No unauthorized derivative permission
checks.evidence: Factories preserve derivative permission; Forbidden path bypasses competition and uses pure native explicit solve; validation still rejects invalid input before callback.

findings.location: crates/vigilode/src/switching.rs: return_ceiling and economical prefilter before same-window replay; solve() rustdoc
findings.issue: The old coalesced rate still screens and bounds adaptive explicit rechecks. Same-window qualification prevents false-positive return choices among screened candidates, but it does not prevent false-negative misses. The general phrase Neither bound changes a decision is too broad if read relative to the new same-window target decision.
findings.minimal_fix: Document that the old-rate gate is a conservative scheduling heuristic with possible missed returns; scope decision-preserving bound claim to that gate. For a future release, occasionally run a finite-budget paired sentinel without the historical-rate ceiling, measuring benefit before default adoption.
findings.suggested_validation: Adversarial time-dependent transition where previous implicit cost is low but current implicit cost rises; compare selected method against matched checkpoint/window alternative including all trial costs.

findings.location: crates/vigilode/src/switching.rs: private productive comparator contract; crates/vigilode/tests/adaptive_entry_contracts.rs return tests
findings.issue: Productive comparator test reconciles attempts and RHS but does not directly assert aggregate Jacobian/JVP/dfdt/linear-solve fields or accepted/rejected sum. Shared charge() makes implementation look correct, yet new branch-specific coverage is narrower than the complete-accounting claim.
findings.minimal_fix: Extend the existing productive comparator fixture with equality for every SwitchingStats work field and assert final t/y consistency. Do not add a duplicate benchmark.
findings.suggested_validation: For attempts, accepts, rejects, RHS, Jacobian, JVP, dfdt and linear solves, compare aggregate with sum of all segment records; success is independent of whether segment committed.

findings.issue: A productive return comparator now intentionally has is_probe=true and committed=true. Reports that count every probe as wasted will misclassify useful implicit work, beyond the baseline advisory-pilot labeling issue.
findings.minimal_fix: Use committed first, then evidence/disposition to classify trial cost; include successful advisory entry separately from discarded losing/incomplete trials.
findings.suggested_validation: Analyzer fixture with productive implicit comparator, successful uncommitted entry advisory, failed entry, and committed explicit recheck, all counted once.
